elements.manual_reason: Small mascot avatar in the answer toolbar mirrors the large face's expression change; only the union box b01 touches it and that box spans the whole panel.
elements.label: Notion AI mascot avatar (small)

pattern.description: After the answer has finished streaming, the hand-drawn mascot face cycles through a few expression poses (brows and eyes shift, settling on a raised-brow, squinting look) on twos, with the small toolbar avatar mirroring it; the UI is otherwise static.
pattern.why_premium: A brief, frame-by-frame expression beat after the answer lands gives the AI a reaction moment, adding personality and a natural pause before the next point without moving the UI.

build_hint.gsap: Hold the UI; on the mascot, swap between 3-4 SVG expression states with a stepped timeline: gsap.timeline().set('.face-a', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.face-b', {autoAlpha: 1}, 0.17).set('.face-b', {autoAlpha: 0}, 0.33).set('.face-c', {autoAlpha: 1}, 0.33); or morph brow/eye paths with ease: 'steps(4)'. Mirror the same timeline on the toolbar avatar.
build_hint.remotion: const pose = poses[Math.min(poses.length - 1, Math.floor(frame / 4))]; render <Mascot pose={pose} /> for both the large face and the toolbar avatar (frame-by-frame swap, no spring).

notes: Energy spikes on alternate frames suggest hand-drawn pose swaps on twos rather than a tween. Small avatar change is inferred from the filmstrip at low resolution; manual box reused from the same position in e017.
